content: In PCA, the principal components give the directions of maximum variance, while their corresponding eigenvalues give the variance of the data in each of them. Therefore, by observing the distribution of the eigenvalues computed when performing PCA in the modeling of the subspaces, we can suggest if the data is suitable or not for subspace representation.
